stories.title: DOJ charges James Comey again, a third prosecution attempt in a year
stories.line: The Justice Department has filed new criminal charges against former FBI Director James Comey, its third prosecution attempt in about a year.

stories.title: US tax deadline arrives tomorrow; filing extensions available as extension guidance published
stories.line: Taxes are due tomorrow, and filing an extension gives more time, though the state auditor says flawed forecasts have distorted government tax revenue estimates.

stories.title: Roche's divarasib outpaces rival KRAS drugs in lung cancer trial
stories.line: Roche's experimental KRAS drug divarasib beat older lung cancer drugs in a late-stage trial, which could give it a strong market position.

stories.title: Apple to replace some iPhone Duo phones after screen defects appear
stories.line: Apple says some first-run iPhone Duo foldables have screen defects and will replace affected units; the number affected is unclear.

stories.title: Country musician Ketch Secor calls on artists to break silence on assault rifles
stories.line: Country musician Ketch Secor is urging other country artists to speak out on gun violence after the Nashville school shooting, despite fear of fan backlash.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine start brief truce so aid can reach stranded Oleshky residents
stories.line: A localized truce began so aid can reach about 2,000 people, including up to 50 children, stranded in occupied Oleshky.

stories.title: Appeals court refuses DOJ bid to pull 20,000 California mail-in ballots
stories.line: A federal appeals court refused to order California to pull about 20,000 mail-in ballots the Justice Department says may be from noncitizens.

stories.title: Appeals court rejects Trump bid to block California from counting 20,000 mail ballots
stories.line: A federal appeals court dismissed the Trump administration's bid to block California from counting mail ballots from 20,000 voters it says are noncitizens.

stories.title: Israel votes in first national election since Oct. 7, with Netanyahu's future at stake
stories.line: Israel holds a national election that will decide whether Benjamin Netanyahu stays in power, its first since the October 7, 2023 attacks.

stories.title: DOJ asks Washington to set aside 400 ballots from suspected noncitizen voters
stories.line: The Justice Department wants Washington state to set aside about 400 ballots from voters it suspects are noncitizens, pending eligibility checks.
